title: The Binding Vine

vibeProfile.oneLine: A grieving woman is drawn into other women's silenced sorrows.

summary: Grieving the death of her baby daughter, Urmi finds herself drawn into other women's buried sorrows: the poems of her dead mother-in-law, trapped in a loveless marriage, and the plight of a young woman brutalised and silenced. Shashi Deshpande's quietly powerful novel connects women across class and generation through shared experiences of loss and violence. Restrained and deeply felt, it is a subtle exploration of grief, marriage and the ties that bind women's lives, from one of India's finest chroniclers of the inner female world.
whyReadIt: Deshpande's quietly powerful novel connecting women across grief, marriage and violence. Restrained and deeply felt.

funFacts.text: Deshpande is among the foremost Indian women novelists writing in English about women's inner lives.
